Rules for every answer:
- Use only the evidence records you are given. Every claim must cite the ids of the evidence records that support it.
- Never invent products, NDCs, dates, availability, reasons or numbers. If the evidence does not say s

value.text:
We need to evaluate each claim against the evidence. Let's go through each claim.

Claim 1: investigator: "Our package NDC 0409-6625-35 is on the FDA shortage list as "Unavailable" with FDA reason category "Other", manufacturer reports manufacturing delay, next delivery January 2027, estimated recovery March 2027." Cited evidence: shortage-0409-6625-35. The evidence says exactly that: availability "Unavailable", FDA reason category "Other", next delivery January 2027, estimated recovery March 2027, manufacturer reports Manufacturing Delay. So claim is supported.

Claim 2: investigator: "Current stock of 308 units covers 16.8 days at 18.4 units per day." Cited stock-11. Evidence: "308 units on hand, 18.4/day over 30 days, 16.8 days of cover". Matches.

Claim 3: investigator: "No ongoing recall for this NDC." Cited search-recall-11. Evidence: "no ongoing recall." Supported.

Claim 4: substitution: "Current sodium bicarbonate 84 mg/mL from Hospira has 16.8 days of cover (stock-11)." Cited stock-11. Evidence shows 16.8 days of cover. Supported.

Claim 5: substitution: "Substitute ANDA219701 is therapeutically equivalent and not on the FDA shortage list." Cited ob-ANDA219701-001, ob-ANDA202432-001, status-ANDA219701. Evidence: ob-ANDA219701-001 shows TE code AP for ANDA219701. ob-ANDA202432-001 shows TE code AP for current product. So therapeutically equivalent (both AP). status-ANDA219701 says none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list. So claim supported.

Claim 6: substitution: "Substitute ANDA216364 is therapeutically equivalent and not on the FDA shortage list." Cited ob-ANDA216364-001, ob-ANDA202432-001, status-ANDA216364. Evidence: ob-ANDA216364-001 shows TE code AP. status-ANDA216364 says none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list. Supported.

Claim 7: substitution: "Substitute ANDA217594 is therapeutically equivalent and not on the FDA shortage list." Cited ob-ANDA217594-001, ob-ANDA202432-001, status-ANDA217594. Evidence: ob-ANDA217594-001 shows TE code AP. status-ANDA217594 says none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list. Supported.

Claim 8: substitution: "ADAPTIS PHARMA PRIVATE LTD ANDA219701: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list; Orange Book ob-ANDA219701-001 matches our product ob-ANDA202432-001; status-ANDA219701 confirms 3 packages at our concentration." Cited status-ANDA219701, ob-ANDA219701-001, ob-ANDA202432-001, ndc-83854-001, ndc-68462-951. The claim includes "Orange Book ob-ANDA219701-001 matches our product ob-ANDA202432-001" which is true (both TE code AP). "status-ANDA219701 confirms 3 packages at our concentration" - status-ANDA219701 says 3 package(s) at our concentration. The NDC records are additional but not needed. All supported.

Claim 9: substitution: "OMNIVIUM PHARMACEUTICALS LLC ANDA216364: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list; Orange Book ob-ANDA216364-001 matches our product ob-ANDA202432-001; status-ANDA216364 confirms 2 packages at our concentration." Cited status-ANDA216364, ob-ANDA216364-001, ob-ANDA202432-001, ndc-81665-200. Evidence supports.

Claim 10: substitution: "STERISCIENCE PTE LTD ANDA217594: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list; Orange Book ob-ANDA217594-001 matches our product ob-ANDA202432-001; status-ANDA217594 confirms 2 packages at our concentration." Cited status-ANDA217594, ob-ANDA217594-001, ob-ANDA202432-001, ndc-82449-000, ndc-70095-050. Evidence supports.

All claims appear supported. No unsupported claims. So output empty list.

But we must be careful: The claim 8 says "Orange Book ob-ANDA219701-001 matches our product ob-ANDA202432-001". That is a reasonable conclusion: both have TE code AP. The evidence shows both have TE code AP. So supported.

Thus unsupported list empty.

We'll output {"unsupported":[]}.</think>{"unsupported":[]}
